review.why: Add login and sign-up to a project with Better Auth: scan the project, agree a plan with the user, then implement routes, database and pages.
review.summary: A two-phase workflow: scan the project for framework, database and existing auth, ask ten structured planning questions, present a checklist plan for confirmation, then implement with a decision tree for new, existing or migrating projects. Includes route handler table per framework, migration commands, adapters and a security checklist.
strengths: Plan first, with explicit confirmation before any code is written, and questions skipped when the scan already knows the answer.
Covers real choices: framework, ORM, sign-in methods, 2FA, organizations, email provider, and the per-adapter migration commands.
Warns that drizzle-kit push is for development only, and ends with a security checklist and troubleshooting table.
cautions: Uses an AskQuestion tool for the planning questions; agents without it must ask in plain text.
Syntax details point to the Better Auth documentation rather than being included.
Read in full but not run here; no license file in the repository.
